text: The chillers and pumps shall be selected for the maximum ambient of 40 degC, with the refrigerant a low-GWP fluid (R1234ze or R513A) and the coil fins epoxy or phenolic coated for C5; the air intakes and the layout shall avoid hot air recirculation and shall have a clearance for the wind (design wind of DP-CASE-0004) and shall be protected against salt spray by a wall or the layout.
